# Tristan Budd

> Software engineer portfolio, projects showcase, blog posts, professional experience, and contact information.

## Primary Sections
- [Home Page](https://tristanbudd.com/): Overview of tech stack, software engineering experience, timeline, and certifications.
- [Projects Directory](https://tristanbudd.com/projects): Full listing of software development projects, case studies, and technical showcases.
- [Blog Posts](https://tristanbudd.com/blog): Technical articles, tutorials, and insights regarding modern web development and software engineering.

## Feeds & Meta
